about_the_game:
LADY DRACULA is the new, upcoming Classicvania from Goth Donut Games!

TRANSFORM into new forms like a wraith, a spider and a bat, in order to fly, climb and blast your way into a new age for the linear Vampire Platformer genre! Jump into a transformation bubble, and float through hazards in Wraith Form, climb along walls and ceilings in Spider Form, or use Bat Form to blast from bubble to bubble across the screen - just be careful not to miss!

OVER 30 stages and more than 10 bosses form a dangerous and thrilling adventure to and through Transylvania and Lady Dracula's castle, varied and colorful environments and spectacular setpieces! Fight across the top of a moving train in a thunderstorm, battle a giant crow from the top of a racing horse carriage, face off against Death himself atop his ghost ship on the river Styx in the depths of Hell. Forests, mountains, caves, cemeteries - LADY DRACULA has it all!

SEVEN different difficulty modes create a never-before-seen difficulty system - LADY DRACULA offers both accessibility for players new to the genre, and extreme challenge for the most diehard Classicvania fans - infinite respawns on the easiest difficulty, and permadeath on the hardest. The most notorious Classicvania gameplay features like air control and player knockback are also customizable!

LADY DRACULA takes Classicvania staples like the long whip, an arcing throwing scythe, and a long-range pistol, and combines them with features less-seen in the genre, like story and dialogue cutscenes, an optional CRT filter, and shapeshifting mechanics!

LADY DRACULA has a soundtrack that defies expectations - please your inner goth with a dark, pulse pounding, modern-quality OST comprised of Industrial Bass, EBM, and Mid-tempo by Mikhail A.G Konov!

LADY DRACULA pays homage to the classics of a bygone age with an art style that utilizes the authentic NES palette, resolution, and sprite color count, while surpassing the console's technical limitations with effects like multi-layered parallax backgrounds, raging storms and huge, detailed monster sprites!

LADY DRACULA is imagined as a sequel to the original Dracula novel by Bram Stoker. In 1897 Transylvania, Dracula is dead, slain by vampire hunters, and his widow, Lady Dracula, has gone mad with grief, and sent demons across the land, to wipe mankind from the Earth. The only one who can stop her is another vampire - you, her daughter, Lady Dracula the Second!

RETURN to 1800s Transylvania, make your way to your mother's looming castle, and strike Lady Dracula down from her tower keep, in LADY DRACULA from GOTH DONUT GAMES!

THE CLASSICVANIA rises from its grave!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7
  • Processor: x86_32 CPU with SSE2 instructions, x86_64 CPU, ARMv8 CPU
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full OpenGL 3.3 support
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: An evolution of the Classicvania genre and a return to the glory days of precision platforming, retro challenge and gothic atmosphere. Transform yourself into a wraith, a spider and a bat to fly, climb and blast your way across Transylvania to do battle with Lady Dracula at her castle keep.
